name: Public Safety Advisory Board Meeting
agenda_text:
AGENDA
  Meeting of the
  PUBLIC SAFETY ADVISORY BOARD
  Westlake Village City Hall
  31200 Oak Crest Drive
  Westlake Village

  Monday, November 14, 2022 at 6:00 p.m.
Due to the ongoing COVID-19 pandemic, Committee Members and staff are participating in this
  meeting via teleconference pursuant to Government Code Section 54953(e).

  In the interest of maintaining appropriate social distancing, a physical location is not being
 provided for the public to attend or comment. Members of the public may observe the meeting
 telephonically or otherwise electronically by using Zoom teleconference service, and may offer
  comment in real time, with the following steps:

  Please click the link below to join the webinar:
  https://us02web.zoom.us/j/81445079303
  Webinar ID: 814 4507 9303
  One tap mobile:
  +16699009128,,81445079303# or +16694449171,,81445079303#
  Telephone:
  +1 669 900 9128 or +1 669 444 9171 or +1 346 248 7799 or +1 719 359 4580

Teleconference participants will be muted until recognized at the appropriate time by the
Committee Chair.

Written Public Comments on agenda items may be sent to the City Clerk's Office at
antoinette@wlv.org no later than 12:00 p.m. on the meeting date. Written comments will be
provided to the Committee.

  In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related
modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services,
  please call the City Clerk’s office at (818) 706-1613 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

  Any disclosable public records related to an open session item on a regular meeting agenda and
  distributed by the City to the Advisory Board less than 72 hours prior to that meeting are available for
 public inspection at City Hall (31200 Oak Crest Drive, Westlake Village) during normal business hours.
 CALL TO ORDER: 6:00 pm

ROLL CALL:  Mayor Halpern, Councilmember Davis

  Members of the Public Safety Advisory Board:
  Tisha Banker, Paul Bronow, Ted Corwin, Stephan Johnson,
  Karen Kimmel, Susan MacLean, Scott Perrotty, Shirley Richards

PUBLIC COMMENTS: Members of the public may offer comment telephonically or otherwise
electronically by using Zoom teleconference service options OR you may email in your comments as listed
on Page 1 of this agenda. Public Comments are for Agenda Items as listed and will be limited to 3 minutes.

BUSINESS:

1.  Pedestrian Safety Educational Campaign – City staff will present options for a
  slogan to build a campaign focused on pedestrian safety.

2.  Reckless Driving Reporting Program – City staff will present a new program to
  assist the community in reporting observations related to reckless driving.

3.  Public Safety Symposium – City staff will provide an overview of an upcoming
  event being held by the Lost Hills Sheriff’s Station on November 19, 2022 at the
  Westlake Village Civic Center.

ADJOURNMENT:

This agenda was posted on Thursday, November 10, 2022 at 1:00 p.m. on the City’s website and in the
Posting Board at City Hall.
